Let me work through this step by step to match the expressions to the missing tags.

The solution starts by setting $a_n = a_1 + f(n)$, which means:
- <missing 1> should be about $a_{n+1}$ in terms of $a_1$ and $f$. This matches expression 1: $a_{n+1}=a_{1}+f(n+1)$
- <missing 2> should be about $a_{n+k}$. This matches expression 10: $a_{n+k}=a_{1}+f(n+k)$

<missing 3> introduces $P$ as a product. Looking at expression 13: $P=\prod_{j=1}^{k}\left ( a_{n+j} \right ) = \prod_{j=1}^{k}\left ( a_{n}+g(j)) \right )$

<missing 4> refers to "the coefficients of" something - this should be $P(a_n)$, which is expression 7.

<missing 5> is a condition for positive coefficients. This should be expression 11: $g(j)=f(n+j)-f(n)\geq 0$

<missing 6> is the expanded form of $P$. This matches expression 18: $P=a_{n}^{k}+C_{k-1}a_{n}^{k-1}+...+C_{1}a_{n}+\prod_{j=1}^{k} g(j) = P(a_{n})$

<missing 7> relates $a_{n+j}$ to other terms. This is expression 14: $a_{n}+g(j)=a_{n+j}=a_{1}+f(n+j)$

<missing 8> solves for $g(j)$. This is expression 20: $g(j)=a_{1}+f(n+j)-a_{n}=a_{1}+f(n+j)-a_{1}-f(n)$

<missing 9> simplifies to expression 8: $f(n+j)-f(n)$

<missing 10> explains why $f(1)=0$, referring to expression 16: $a_{1}=a_{1}+f(1)$

<missing 11> refers back to the expression for $g(j)$, which is expression 8: $f(n+j)-f(n)$

<missing 12> introduces the linear form, expression 15: $f(n)=mn+b$

<missing 13> refers to the intercept position, which is expression 9: $n=0$

<missing 14> applies the condition $f(1)=0$, giving expression 4: $f(1)=m+b=0$

<missing 15> solves for $b$, giving expression 21: $b=-m$

<missing 16> shows the final form of $f(n)$, expression 19: $f(n)=mn-m=(n-1)m$

<missing 17> states the condition on $m$, expression 3: $m\geq 0 \mid m \in \mathbb{Z}$

<missing 18> shows $g(j)$ with the linear $f$, expression 6: $g(j)=f(n+j)-f(n)=(n+j-1)m-(n-1)m=jm$

<missing 19> shows the final polynomial form, expression 2: $\prod_{j=1}^{k}\left ( a_{n}+jm \right )=P(a_{n})=a_{n}^{k}+C_{k-1}a_{n}^{k-1}+...+C_{1}a_{n}+k!m^{k}$

<missing 20> identifies $C_0$, expression 5: $C_{0}=k!m^{k}$

<missing 21> refers to "coefficients of polynomial" - this should be expression 17: $\geq 0$

<missing 22> gives final form of $a_n$, expression 24: $a_{n}=a_{1}+(n-1)m$

<missing 23> gives condition on $a_1$, expression 12: $a_{1} \geq 1 \mid a_{1} \in \mathbb{Z}$

<missing 24> gives condition on $m$, expression 23: $\forall m\geq 0 \mid m \in \mathbb{Z}$

Answer: 1, 10, 13, 7, 11, 18, 14, 20, 8, 16, 8, 15, 9, 4, 21, 19, 3, 6, 2, 5, 17, 24, 12, 23
